title: Rapid Revision Priorities in the Last Seven Days
subject: Time Management
preview: In the last week, prioritize high-frequency weaknesses and repeated mistakes rather than launching broad new resources.
quickRevision: In the last week, prioritize high-frequency weaknesses and repeated mistakes rather than launching broad new resources.
Focus on red-flag presentations, core algorithms, formulas and common exam confusions.
Reduce last-minute switching between multiple conflicting note sets.
